name: Seer
actingPrinciples: Act as a real fortune-teller rather than merely possessing divination powers.
Respect fate and avoid extracting excessive personal benefit from divination.
Do not treat divination as omnipotent; avoid recklessly divining matters involving high-level existences.
milestones: Chooses the Seer pathway and drinks the potion.
Uses the Divination Club as a practical acting environment.
Gradually summarizes his own Seer principles and recognizes the acting method.
Fully digests the potion before preparing for Clown.

source.note: Potion composition, acting principles and full digestion are directly supported by the supplied EPUB.

name: Clown

mainIngredients: Single horn of a matured Hornacis gray mountain goat

actingEvidence: The EPUB does not provide a clean enumerated Clown principle in the passages located so far. Klein explicitly asks how to act as a Clown, and the Lanevus scene visually ties laughter, grief, and the clown mask to complete digestion; this is kept as evidence rather than converted into a canonical rule.
abilities: Enhanced agility, speed and combat learning
Fleeting intuitive prediction of another person's next action
Improved control of expressions and body language
milestones: Advances in Chapter 168 after passing the Church examination.
Tests the dramatic increase in coordination, balance and combat capability in Chapter 169.
Carries Clown-stage abilities into the end of the Tingen arc and early Backlund period.
Completes digestion during the Lanevus revenge scene in Chapter 287.

source.note: Promotion, formula, abilities and Chapter 287 digestion are explicit; the consolidated acting principle remains intentionally unasserted.

name: Magician

mainIngredients: One true root of a Mist Treant
All spinal fluid of a Dark Patterned Black Panther

actingPrinciples: Never perform unprepared.
Challenge the impossible, even if the final outcome is only an illusion.
Take the initiative to perform.
Seek applause from the audience.
Control the target's attention.
milestones: Finishes gathering the ingredients immediately before advancement.
Begins experimenting with performances and audience feedback to accelerate digestion.
Concludes the five principal Magician rules.
Uses the resulting escape and deception toolkit throughout Sherlock-era investigations.

source.note: Formula, all five Magician principles and multiple core spell-like abilities are explicit in the supplied EPUB.

name: Faceless

mainIngredients: Mutated pituitary gland of a Thousand-faced Hunter
supplementaryIngredients: 3 strands of hair from a Deep-sea Naga

actingPrinciples: You can disguise yourself as anyone, but you are ultimately yourself.
Get into character while remaining detached from the role.
Overcome aversion when acting, but do not become over-immersed.
Disguise yourself as another person and obtain genuine feedback from others.
milestones: Advances in Backlund.
Uses multiple identities and lived experiences to refine acting.
Learns that preserving the self is the core defense against losing control.
Creates Gehrman Sparrow as a deliberately distinct sea-going persona.

source.note: Formula and Faceless acting principles are directly described in the supplied EPUB.

name: Marionettist

mainIngredients: Core crystal of a six-winged gargoyle
supplementaryIngredients: 80 ml spring water from Sonia Island's Golden Spring
One pair of eyes from a six-winged gargoyle

ritual: Consume the potion in the midst of a singing mermaid's song.
actingPrinciples: Avoid personally doing what can be delegated to a marionette when the situation does not require direct action.
Give each marionette a distinct identity and setting so it behaves as a believable individual.
abilities: Initial control of a target through Spirit Body Threads
Control marionettes while retaining their original Beyonder powers
milestones: Learns the advancement ritual long before he can use it.
Prepares the potion and sails to where mermaids can be found.
Drinks the potion while mermaids sing.
Chapter 665 immediately demonstrates Spirit Body Threads.
Refines his acting by developing unique marionette identities.

source.note: Formula, ritual, Spirit Body Thread mechanics and the marionette identity principle are explicit.

name: Bizarro Sorcerer

mainIngredients: True soul body of a Spirit World Plunderer

ritual: Using one's own strength and strategy, orchestrate a grand performance before many spectators to kill a demigod-level Beyonder creature, then consume the potion at the end of the performance.
actingPrinciples: Handle matters in deliberately bizarre and eerie ways without needlessly harming innocents.
Create strange or frightening stories and situations that generate genuine spectator feedback.
Use the reaction and spread of bizarre legends to accelerate digestion.
abilities: Allow marionettes to use the Bizarro Sorcerer's Beyonder powers
Instantly swap positions with a marionette
Greatly enhance marionette control distance and lifelike behavior
Qualitative enhancement of previous Seer-pathway deception and transformation abilities
milestones: Obtains and verifies the Bizarro Sorcerer formula before advancement.
Completes the demigod-level advancement ritual and reaches Sequence 4.
Uses eerie urban legends and bizarre performances to accelerate digestion.
Turns hospitals, historical incidents and frightening legends into acting opportunities while preparing for Scholar of Yore.

source.note: Formula and ritual are explicit. Later passages directly connect bizarre/eerie performances, spectator feedback and frightening legends to digestion.

name: Scholar of Yore

mainIngredients: A pair of eyes from a Hound of Fulgrim / Sefirah Castle Keeper
One Demonic Wolf of Fog transformed heart
supplementaryIngredients: 30 grams White Frost Crystal of a Demonic Wolf of Fog
A large amount of genuine ancient historical records

ritual: Be separated from reality for at least three hundred years; consume the potion after becoming history and no longer belonging to the present era.
actingPrinciples: Pursue and reconstruct real ancient history rather than collecting disconnected trivia.
Approach history as a scholar: connect events, understand causes and recover the actual process behind the past.
abilities: Borrowing power from one's past self
milestones: Learns that his centuries suspended above the gray fog already satisfy the unusual advancement condition.
Advances on an isolated Berserk Sea island.
Uses genuine ancient historical records as supplementary ingredients.
Links digestion to uncovering and reconstructing hidden history.
By Chapter 1169 the potion is explicitly described as completely digested.

source.note: Formula, three-hundred-year ritual, Historical Void mechanics and Chapter 1169 full digestion are directly supported.

name: Miracle Invoker

mainIngredients: Heart of the Dark Demonic Wolf / God of Wishes, or the Beyonder characteristic of another Miracle Invoker

ritual: Return a piece of history that has been left behind to the present era.
actingPrinciples: Accumulate wishes by satisfying other people's wishes.
Create real miracles step by step rather than treating wishes as unlimited power.
Walk the real world as a wandering magician so people can witness miracles and have their wishes fulfilled.
abilities: Further qualitative enhancement of historical abilities
milestones: Advances to Sequence 2 angel level.
Discovers that Wishes require accumulated fulfilled wishes rather than unrestricted use.
Builds the Merlin Hermes identity around satisfying wishes in the real world.
By Chapter 1316, explicitly states that he has concluded the Miracle Invoker acting principles.
The final portion of the potion is digested immediately before the Attendant of Mysteries advancement at the end of Chapter 1351.

source.note: Formula, historical-return ritual, Wishes mechanism, acting progress and final digestion are directly described.

name: Attendant of Mysteries

mainIngredients: One Attendant of Mysteries Beyonder characteristic

ritual: Build a town consisting only of marionettes and design a trajectory of fate for every marionette. Their interactions must form a sufficiently realistic living picture that creates a corresponding region in the spirit world; larger, richer and more realistic towns improve the ritual.
digestionMechanism: After stabilizing his anchors and resisting the awakening of Celestial Worthy, Klein plans to remove the undigested extra Attendant of Mysteries characteristic into an avatar/marionette, leaving himself at the level of a fully digested Attendant of Mysteries.
abilities: Regenerate: restore vanished Spirit Body Threads to eligible materials and turn them into marionettes
Reassembly / Tampering / Grafting: combine physical objects or abstract concepts into new relationships and effects
Realm of Mysteries: create an embryonic divine kingdom with concealment
Deeper control of Sefirah Castle and access to powers nearing Sequence 0
milestones: Constructs Utopia as the marionette town required by the ritual.
Uses the town's real-world interactions to produce the matching spirit-world region.
Advances while Adam is being held back and the ritual effect remains active.
Chapter 1356 explicitly names Regenerate, Reassembly/Tampering and Realm of Mysteries as the three most important new powers.
His immediate post-advancement objective becomes qualifying for The Fool apotheosis while resisting Celestial Worthy.

source.note: Formula, Utopia ritual, advancement and the three major Sequence 1 powers are directly described. No separate ordinary acting-rule list is asserted.

name: The Fool

mainIngredients: Two Attendant of Mysteries Beyonder characteristics apart from one's own characteristic
supplementaryIngredients: Control at least one quarter of the fog of history

ritual: Fool time, history, or fate once.
abilities: Embodiment of the pathway's corresponding authorities
Sequence-0 level expression of prior Seer-pathway authorities
milestones: Learns the apotheosis requirement directly from The Fool Card of Blasphemy.
Chooses history as the most familiar target for the ritual and develops a plan around making the Tarot Club's belief about an awakening ancient Fool become reality.
The Fool identity and Klein's personal Sequence progression finally converge.
The apotheosis is contested during the endgame conflict with Amon.
The resulting Sequence 0 state becomes inseparable from Sefirah Castle and the larger Lord of Mysteries struggle.

source.note: The Fool Card explicitly gives the ingredients and ritual: control part of the fog of history and fool time, history or fate once. The apotheosis event is anchored to Chapter 1380.
